start._comment: `.docusaurus-dev` instead of the default `.docusaurus`, because `docusaurus start` and `docusaurus build` generate into the SAME folder. A build run while the dev server is up (`nx build docs`, or anything that depends on it) overwrites that folder underneath it; the watcher sees the change and recompiles the running site from the build's leftovers - production config, and the last locale built, which is `cs`. The English dev site then believes its baseUrl is `/cs/`, so every link and every hot reload lands on a path it does not serve: a 404 in the other language, out of nowhere, on the next keystroke. Separate folders make that collision impossible.

gen-json-schema._comment: The published import schema (plan §1, ADR-0014). Generated from the domain's own SETTINGS registry and SCHEMA_VERSION, so it can never describe last month's shape. Lands in static/, which Docusaurus copies to the site root — https://achordeon.eu/achordeon.schema.json, one stable URL with no version in the path.

clear._comment: Both generated folders: `docusaurus clear` only knows about the one it is pointed at, and the dev server's (see `start`) is exactly the one somebody reaches for `clear` to unstick.
